text:
maria: Heads-up — change window starts at 09:00 PT (in ~15m). Final freeze in 10m. Quick checklist below, please ack and call any blockers now.
kevin: Ack. list please.
sophie: Smoke + gen quality + perf smoke. embeddings, streaming, kv cache warm, tracing enabled.
tariq: Canary image: `3.2.1-canary`. Who's pinning?
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued: `canary 3.2.1-canary` -> plan: 20% traffic, 30m, autoscale=on. To start manually: `/deploy canary 3.2.1-canary`.
oliver: Release notes posted: https://docs.internal/release/3.2.1 (changelog + customer-facing blurb). No DB migrations.
kevin: Rollback thresholds we agreed: error_rate > 2% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency > 1.2s for 5m -> immediate rollback and incident.
sophie: Also gate on gen-quality: run eval set (quick prompts) against canary responses; if character regressions > 0.5% flag.
tariq: Owning rollback: maria + oncall SRE. OLIVER — can you be ready to pin back if needed?
maria: Yes. If rollback: steps are in playbook — 1) `/pin 3.2.0-stable`, 2) notify #incidents and product comms, 3) create incident with template and link to CI artifacts.
oliver: Got it, playbook open and terminal ready.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started at 09:05 PT. 20% traffic -> health checks passing. metrics snapshot: error_rate 0.10%, p95=420ms, cpu 48%.
sophie: Running quick gen eval now — samples look normal so far. embeddings smoke ok. kv warm successful.
kevin: Console: dashboards pinned, traces on, sampling at 5%. I increased alert sensitivity for 15m after promo.
tariq: :thumbsup: watching logs + tailing prom queries.
maria: Reminder: keep human gate for 15m after promoting to 100%. If anything odd, call rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary ended — result: PASS. Promoting to 100% in 5m.
maria: Proceed with promo. Notify here as soon as promo completes and after 15m stability window. :rocket:
kevin: Release notes pushed to customer comms draft, product will finish recipients.
sophie: I'll post a final status update when promo completes and after 15m check. Thanks team.
oliver: Ready to execute rollback if needed.
maria: Great work — keep channels open.
